skill.summary: Automate punching time in/out on WPS Time / NetTime (wpstime.com NetTime). Use for phrases like setup punchclock/configure punchclock/set up time clock, clock in/clock out, start break/end break, start lunch/end lunch, check status/status. Runs a Playwright flow, captures a screenshot, and replies with a brief confirmation.
